tables.name: attendee
tables.description: Registry of people who may attend conference presentations. Attendee contact details and VIP status are stored here; nullable contact and VIP values support incomplete records.

columns.name: attendee_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for an attendee.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Attendee's given name.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Attendee's family name.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Contact phone number stored as text so leading zeroes are preserved; may be NULL.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Contact email address; may be NULL, and duplicate values are possible in the practice data.

columns.name: vip
columns.description: VIP indicator, typically 'yes' or 'no'; may be NULL.

tables.name: room
tables.description: Conference room inventory. Each record identifies a room's floor and seating capacity, including rooms with low capacity for edge-case queries.

columns.name: room_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for a conference room.

columns.name: floor_number
columns.description: Floor on which the room is located.

columns.name: seat_capacity
columns.description: Maximum number of seats in the room.

tables.name: company
tables.description: Organizations associated with the conference. A company may have a primary contact attendee; company names are not unique, and contact or description values may be NULL.

columns.name: company_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for a company.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Company or organization name; duplicate names are present in the data.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Short description of the company's business or industry; may be NULL.

columns.name: primary_contact_attendee_id
columns.description: Nullable foreign key to the attendee who is the company's primary contact.

tables.name: presentation
tables.description: Scheduled conference presentations. A presentation may be associated with a booking company and room, both of which are nullable, and has a start and end time.

columns.name: presentation_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for a presentation.

columns.name: booked_company_id
columns.description: Nullable foreign key to the company booking or sponsoring the presentation.

columns.name: booked_room_id
columns.description: Nullable foreign key to the room assigned to the presentation.

columns.name: start_time
columns.description: Scheduled presentation start date and time.

columns.name: end_time
columns.description: Scheduled presentation end date and time; constrained to be later than start_time.

tables.name: presentation_attendance
tables.description: Ticket and attendance junction table linking attendees to presentations. Each ticket is unique; multiple tickets can link the same attendee to the same presentation in the edge-case data.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.description: Unique ticket identifier for an attendance record.

columns.name: presentation_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the presentation associated with this ticket.

columns.name: attendee_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the attendee associated with this ticket.
